# North H Form

## About
North H Form started as a simple tool for teams tired of clunky form builders that force rigid templates. The platform lets users drag and drop fields, set conditional logic, and connect responses straight to tools like Slack or Google Sheets. It grew into a full workspace where marketing teams, operations folks, and researchers design, launch, and analyze forms in one place with a focus on clean data output. Founded in 2022, the company keeps development lean with a free tier that supports real work and transparent pricing.

**Areas of Work:** Software & Internet, Form Builder Software, SaaS Tools, Data Collection
